name: sayanox-edge
description: Ultra-fast static site optimizer & Cloudflare performance toolkit. Minify HTML/CSS/JS, optimize images to WebP, generate cache headers, and get Cloudflare recommendations — in one command.

scripts.test: node bin/sayanox-edge.js optimize examples/sample-site --out dist-sample && node bin/sayanox-edge.js cf-rules examples/sample-site
